description: InterruptedMoveTransactions.recover: a move quarantines the source (rename to '.clio-move-source-<id>') after the destination holds the candidate. States: source absent|present, quarantine absent|present, destination absent|expected|candidate|other. `expected` is the destination revision recorded in the manifest (a replace); a create records none (destinationRecorded false). Outcome: `checkpoint` is whether an interruptedMove journal record holding the source bytes is written, `sourceRemains` whether the source file is still visible afterwards, `manifestRemoved` whether the manifest is deleted, `recovered` the return value. Source bytes and candidate bytes are identical; `other` is unrelated content.

rows.name: replace: destination installed, source still visible
create: destination installed, source still visible

authorization: A manifest is actionable only when both its source root and destination root lie inside the set of roots the caller passes in.
A cross-workspace manifest is left untouched until both roots are in that set.
A manifest whose paths escape its roots, whose quarantine name does not match '.clio-move-source-<id>', or that is a symbolic link or junction, is ignored.
